mapper.sql: task_id, task_name, description, status, dataset_id, algorithm_id, hyper_id, custom_params, start_time, end_time, progress, output_dataset_id, cleaning_result, execution_snapshot, current_run_id, current_attempt, create_by, update_by, create_time, update_time

where.if: and ( task_name like concat('%', #{criteria.blurry}, '%') or description like concat('%', #{criteria.blurry}, '%') )

mapper.select:
select
from sys_pre_defense
order by task_id desc

select
from sys_pre_defense where status = #{status} order by task_id desc

select
from sys_pre_defense where dataset_id = #{datasetId} order by task_id desc

select
from sys_pre_defense where algorithm_id = #{algorithmId} order by task_id desc

select
from sys_pre_defense where create_by = #{createBy} order by task_id desc
mapper.update: update sys_pre_defense set status = 'pending', progress = 0, start_time = null, end_time = null, output_dataset_id = null, cleaning_result = null, current_run_id = null, current_attempt = null, update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and status = 'failed'

update sys_pre_defense set status = 'running', progress = 1, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = null, output_dataset_id = null, cleaning_result = null, execution_snapshot = #{executionSnapshot}, current_run_id = #{runId}, current_attempt = #{attempt}, update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and status = 'pending'

update sys_pre_defense set output_dataset_id = #{outputDatasetId}, cleaning_result = #{cleaningResult}, update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and current_run_id = #{runId} and status = 'running'
update sys_pre_defense set status = #{status}, progress = #{progress}, end_time = #{endTime}, update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and current_run_id = #{runId} and status = 'running'

update sys_pre_defense set status = 'canceled', cleaning_result = #{cleaningResult}, end_time = #{endTime}, update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and current_run_id = #{runId} and status = 'running'

update sys_pre_defense set status = 'failed', progress = 0, cleaning_result = #{cleaningResult}, end_time = #{endTime}, update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and status = 'running' and ( current_run_id = #{runId} or (current_run_id is null and #{runId} is null) )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_tasks, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'success' THEN 1 END) as success_tasks, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'failed' THEN 1 END) as failed_tasks, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'canceled' THEN 1 END) as canceled_tasks, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'running' THEN 1 END) as running_tasks, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'pending' THEN 1 END) as pending_tasks, AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'success' THEN progress END) as avg_progress, AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'success' AND start_time IS NOT NULL AND end_time IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, start_time, end_time) END) as avg_duration_minutes FROM sys_pre_defense

SELECT algorithm_id, COUNT(*) as usage_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'success' THEN 1 END) as success_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'failed' THEN 1 END) as failed_count, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'success' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) as success_rate FROM sys_pre_defense WHERE algorithm_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY algorithm_id ORDER BY usage_count DESC

SELECT dataset_id, COUNT(*) as usage_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'success' THEN 1 END) as success_count, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'success' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) as success_rate FROM sys_pre_defense WHERE dataset_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY dataset_id ORDER BY usage_count DESC

SELECT DATE(create_time) as date, COUNT(*) as task_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'success' THEN 1 END) as success_count FROM sys_pre_defense WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date DESC
